name: External Payment Group Status 1 Code
definition: Specifies the status of a group of payment instructions, as published in an external payment group status code set.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

ACCP.name: Accepted Customer Profile
ACCP.definition: Preceding check of technical validation was successful. Customer profile check was also successful.

ACCC.name: Accepted Settlement Completed Creditor Account
ACCC.definition: Settlement on the creditor's account has been completed.

ACSC.name: Accepted Settlement Completed Debitor Account
ACSC.definition: Settlement on the debtor's account has been completed.|Usage : this can be used by the first agent to report to the debtor that the transaction has been completed. |Warning : this status is provided for transaction status reasons, not for financial information. It can only be used after bilateral agreement

ACSP.name: Accepted Settlement In Process
ACSP.definition: All preceding checks such as technical validation and customer profile were successful and therefore the payment initiation has been accepted for execution.

ACTC.name: Accepted Technical Validation
ACTC.definition: Authentication and syntactical and semantical validation are successful

ACWC.name: Accepted With Change
ACWC.definition: Instruction is accepted but a change will be made, such as date or remittance not sent.

PART.name: Partially Accepted
PART.definition: A number of transactions have been accepted, whereas another number of transactions have not yet achieved|'accepted' status.

PDNG.name: Pending
PDNG.definition: Payment initiation or individual transaction included in the payment initiation is pending. Further checks and status update will be performed.

RCVD.name: Received
RCVD.definition: Payment initiation has been received by the receiving agent

RJCT.name: Rejected
RJCT.definition: Payment initiation or individual transaction included in the payment initiation has been rejected.

RCVC.name: Received Verification Completed
RCVC.definition: Verification of Payee check have been applied to received transactions stating to be complete without mismatching data.

RVCM.name: Received Verification Completed With Mismatches
RVCM.definition: Verification of Payee checks have been applied to received transactions stating to be complete containing mismatching data.

RVNC.name: Received Verification Not Completed
RVNC.definition: Verification of party check on transactions received is not yet completed.
